headline: Ladybird browser's first alpha arrives for macOS and Linux
summary: Independent browser project Ladybird released its first downloadable alpha for macOS and Linux, built on a from-scratch engine rather than an existing one. Outlets confirm the build is available after years of development. Coverage differs in tone: one review calls the alpha surprisingly capable, while another notes it ships without security guarantees.
